generatedFor: Manual service requests that can become paid orders without collecting payment on the site.
publicSafeFields: business, booth, event, or service name
what the buyer sells or promotes
up to 12 items or services with prices
public QR/contact link or public-safe reply preference
notes that do not include private payment or identity data

statuses.ownerAction: A buyer submits the structured issue form, prefilled issue, email, or brief text.
Confirm the request is within the simple $29 scope and details are complete enough.
statuses.buyerAction: Confirm scope and that the QR/contact link can be printed publicly.

statuses.ownerAction: Send one real external Gumroad, Payhip, Ko-fi, Stripe, or invoice checkout link.
statuses.buyerAction: Pay only through the external provider.
statuses.moneyRule: Not revenue until the provider confirms payment.

statuses.ownerAction: Verify paid order, payout balance, or settled payment in the provider dashboard.
statuses.moneyRule: This is the first status that can count as revenue.

statuses.ownerAction: Prepare the editable starter CSV, flyer copy, QR sign wording, coupon ideas, packing notes, and launch checklist.
statuses.buyerAction: Answer scope clarifications only if needed.

statuses.ownerAction: Send the pack through the agreed channel with review and QR-test reminders.
statuses.buyerAction: Review all copy, prices, QR links, and claims before printing.

statuses.ownerAction: Complete the included lightweight typo or fit revision if requested.
statuses.buyerAction: Confirm the revision request is within scope.
statuses.moneyRule: No extra revenue unless a separate new paid scope is created.

statuses.ownerAction: Log the non-sensitive outcome in OPERATIONS.md and leave private payment details in the provider only.
statuses.buyerAction: Use the editable pack in their own business or event workflow.
statuses.moneyRule: Final counted revenue must match the external provider record.

moneyGate: Revenue is proven only after a real payment provider shows a paid order, payout balance, or settled payment for this service.
riskControls: The service does not start until a real external payment link is sent and paid.
No payout, tax, bank, card, identity, or platform credential is stored in the repository.
The buyer must review all copy, prices, QR links, and claims before printing or publishing.
No legal, tax, accounting, employment, medical, or financial advice is included.
One lightweight revision is included for typos or fit; new branding, logo design, or legal copy is out of scope.
